title: fix a bug: Convert multi weight slice file
body: The model [https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf](url) has two `.bin` files. They are two slices of model. The pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.bin contains 0-23, and the pytorch_model-00002-of-00002.bin  contains 24-31.

title: [FIX] Fix simulator bug
body:
1. Fixed a bug in exploring the best_config for vllm through `simdistserve/simulate.py`.
2. Modified the definition of `figure_11_vllm_low` in `simdistserve/benchmarks/figure11-ablation/03-draw_slo_ablation.py`.
3. Updated `simdistserve/benchmarks/search_binary.py` to adjust tp and pp settings, and to pass `args.backend`.
4. Corrected the issue in `simdistserve/benchmarks/simulate_dist.py` where the TP_Prefill value was being passed as TP_Decode in the following code section:
   ```python
   worker_config = WorkerConfig(
       model_type=model_type,
       TP=TP_Prefill, TP_Prefill=TP_Prefill, TP_Decode=TP_Prefill,
       prefill_max_batch_size=10 ** 7,  # inf
       decode_max_batch_size=10 ** 7,  # inf
       prefill_max_tokens=prefill_max_tokens,
       decode_max_tokens=decode_max_tokens,
       enable_chunked_prefill=False,
       engine_type=args.backend,
   )
   ```
